## What changed?

Describe the project update or website change.

## Check before merging

- [ ] Project title, date and summary are correct.
- [ ] Photos are in `public/assets/images/` with descriptive alt text.
- [ ] The business has permission to publish the content and photos.
- [ ] `draft: false` is set only when the update is ready for the public site.
- [ ] The **Validate and build** check passes.

Merging into `main` publishes the website automatically.
